newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore gasoil trades at 5-yr high of $30.55/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Singapore gasoil trades at 5-yr high of $30.55/bbl.

text.p: Singapore physical gas oil traded on Friday at new five-year high of $30.55 per barrel, traders said.
Traders confirmed the sale of 230,000 barrels of gas oil lifting November 2-6 on a free-on-board basis from Singapore by Shell Singapore to U.S. trader Cargill.
The deal surpassed the previous high of $30.00 which traded last week. The October 27-31 cargo was also sold by Shell.
A trader said the high gas oil prices could no longer be attributed to the flatering rise in crude or to strong fundamentals.
"It was a good number to sell short," he said, indicating he expected gas oil prices to fall near term.
